messages:
emma (PM): Quick sync — customer asked for per-request top_k overrides + backcompat with old "candidates" payload. Need decision on defaults, truncation policy, score normalization, and rollout scope.

mike (Eng): Can we get a sample payload to align? also any perf targets?

emma (PM): example payload:
```
{
  "query": "find relevant docs about billing",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "doc text...", "meta": {"source": "kb"}},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "other doc..."}
  ],
  "top_k": 50,
  "truncate_candidates": true,
  "score_normalization": "none | minmax | softmax"
}
```

raj (ML): For telemetry/comparability we should offer softmax normalization. But softmax across many candidates adds compute & numeric stability work. Defaulting to RAW (no normalization) avoids perf regressions for PLG.

olivia (PD): Product ask: default top_k should be 10 for self-serve. Truncation: cap candidate text to 200 tokens server-side with a warning in response. Reject >500 candidates with 429 + guidance.

sarah (Sales): Enterprise asks: per-customer top_k cap (configurable) + SLA: p95 latency <120ms for top_k <= 20. Also audit logs for truncated candidates.

mike (Eng): Implementation note — large top_k interacts badly with batching. Default 16 top_k is a safer perf sweet spot. For >50 we should route to async rerank job + webhook.

emma (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria:
- API accepts either `candidates` array or legacy `docs` field for backcompat
- Default `top_k` = 10, server-side truncation to 200 tokens, 429 for >500 candidates
- `score_normalization` default = "raw", optional "softmax" and "minmax" with documented cost
- Per-customer caps exposed in org settings
- Rollout behind feature flag + canary to 10% of traffic

deploy-bot: feature flag created: feature/rerank-backcompat (owner: @mike)

raj (ML): Offline eval plan: run 5k queries, compare raw vs softmax vs minmax on pairwise agreement and NDCG, report perf delta (CPU/GPU) and latency.

mike (Eng): I'll implement compatibility layer + server truncation. plan: PR next week, canary after QA.

olivia (PD): Owners: emma (PM) owner for acceptance; mike (Eng) for impl; raj (ML) for eval; olivia for rollout docs. Target milestone = 2 sprint cycle (14 days).

sarah (Sales): Please surface enterprise config API for per-customer caps — I'll collect customer asks and config requirements.

emma (PM): Sounds good. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they agree on scope and owners?

mike (Eng): :thumbsup:
raj (ML): :thumbsup:
olivia (PD): :thumbsup:
sarah (Sales): :thumbsup:
